if: input tax credit is claimed in respect of an invoice or debit note for a supply of goods or services or both
the claim is made after the statutory cut-off for the financial year to which the invoice or debit note pertains, or after the relevant annual return is furnished, whichever is earlier
then: CONFLICT — the two locally held sources state the cut-off differently and this file resolves neither. Source A: the due date of furnishing of the return under section 39 for the month of SEPTEMBER following the end of that financial year. Source B: the THIRTIETH DAY OF NOVEMBER following the end of that financial year
note: This is the highest-value conflict in the ITC set: it decides whether a late credit is time-barred, and the two sources differ by roughly six weeks. Source B carries a footnote recording substitution by Act 6 of 2022 with effect from 1-10-2022, which post-dates source A. The determination of which text governs a given financial year is a legal question and is deliberately left open. Do not compute a deadline from either text alone.
